quotes.en: Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
quotes.zh: 照顾好你的身体，它是你唯一真正拥有的居所。

quotes.en: Turn your face to the sun and the shadows fall behind you.
quotes.zh: 把脸转向阳光，阴影就会落在身后。

quotes.en: Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes. Including you.
quotes.zh: 几乎所有东西，拔掉插头几分钟再插上就能重新工作——包括你自己。

quotes.en: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
quotes.zh: 大自然从不匆忙，却一切都得以完成。

quotes.en: The time to relax is when you don't have time for it.
quotes.zh: 最该放松的时候，恰恰是你觉得没时间放松的时候。

quotes.en: Take rest; a field that has rested gives a bountiful crop.
quotes.zh: 要休息；休耕过的田野，会有丰盛的收成。

quotes.authorZh: 亨利 · 戴维 · 梭罗
quotes.en: It is not enough to be busy. The question is: what are we busy about?
quotes.zh: 光是忙碌还不够，问题是：我们在忙些什么？

quotes.en: Health is the greatest gift, contentment the greatest wealth.
quotes.zh: 健康是最大的礼物，知足是最大的财富。

quotes.en: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
quotes.zh: 早睡早起，使人健康、富有、明智。

quotes.en: The greatest wealth is health.
quotes.zh: 最大的财富是健康。

quotes.en: A calm mind brings inner strength and self-confidence.
quotes.zh: 平静的心，带来内在的力量与自信。

quotes.en: You should sit in meditation for twenty minutes every day — unless you're too busy. Then you should sit for an hour.
quotes.zh: 每天应静坐二十分钟——除非你太忙，那就坐一小时。

quotes.en: Rest when you're weary. Refresh and renew yourself — your body, your mind, your spirit. Then get back to work.
quotes.zh: 累了就休息。让身体、心灵和精神焕然一新，然后再回去工作。

quotes.en: Tension is who you think you should be; relaxation is who you are.
quotes.zh: 紧张，是你以为自己应该成为的样子；放松，是你本来的样子。

quotes.en: Don't count the days; make the days count.
quotes.zh: 不要数日子，要让日子过得有价值。

quotes.en: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quotes.zh: 成就伟大工作的唯一方式，是热爱你所做的事。

quotes.en: Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.
quotes.zh: 无论你觉得自己能还是不能，你都是对的。

quotes.en: It always seems impossible until it's done.
quotes.zh: 在完成之前，一切似乎都不可能。

quotes.en: What lies in our power to do, lies in our power not to do.
quotes.zh: 在我们能力之内能做的事，也在能力之内可以不做。

quotes.en: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.zh: 做得好，胜过说得好。

quotes.en: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.zh: 不能主宰自己的人，不算自由。

quotes.en: He who has health has hope; and he who has hope has everything.
quotes.zh: 拥有健康就拥有希望，拥有希望就拥有一切。

quotes.en: The mind is not a vessel to be filled, but a fire to be kindled.
quotes.zh: 心灵不是需要填满的容器，而是需要点燃的火焰。

quotes.en: Nothing is particularly hard if you divide it into small jobs.
quotes.zh: 把事情拆成小块，就没有特别难的事。
